Volkswagen Warns of Profit Hit After Porsche Write-Down

Volkswagen has warned of a significant impact on its profits due to a write-down related to its Porsche investment and restructuring costs. The company anticipates a potential hit of up to €10 billion. This warning follows financial assessments concerning its stake in Porsche.
